# Munchee

> What should I eat? Munchee suggests vegetarian and vegan recipes from the ingredients you already have, the time you've got, and the nutrition you want, so fridge and pantry items don't go to waste.

Live: https://munchee.vayuputra.co/

## Features

- 33,199 vegetarian recipes, 7,118 of them vegan, from the Food.com dataset
- Ingredient search with autocomplete and a browsable ingredient panel
- Smart ingredient matching (garlic clove counts as garlic, but tomato paste is not fresh tomato)
- Filters for cooking time and nutrition goals
- Nutrition per serving and step-by-step instructions

## Useful for

- Deciding what to cook for dinner with what's on hand
- Using up leftover ingredients to cut food waste
- Finding quick vegetarian or vegan meals that fit a time limit or nutrition goal

## About

- Free, no sign-up, nothing to install; runs entirely in your browser.
- Made by [Suraj Malpani](https://surajmalpani.github.io/), published by [Vayuputra](https://vayuputra.co/), which lists all its free tools.
